description: Ad Spend Airlock — governed automation for Google Ads™ (API v25): the deep, governed Google Ads module: let an AI agent run campaigns, keywords, bids and creatives without ever letting it silently burn your budget. 40 commands: 22 reads (side_effects=none — spend, performance, budgets, keywords, conversions, recommendations, change history, account metadata incl. currency/test-vs-live, shared-budget blast radius, and a SELECT-only GAQL query) so the agent optimizes freely; 18 writes (mode=write_requires_approval) so every money-moving change stops at the RailCall airlock: dry-run preview (Google validateOnly, nothing changes) then human approve then execute then Ed25519 signed receipt. Every budget raise, bid change, new keyword, applied recommendation and published ad shows the exact oldthennew before it fires; new campaigns and ads are created PAUSED. 2026s #1 agent failure is runaway spend (recursive loops burning five figures in a weekend); this is the ceiling that stops it, and the signed audit trail gives a human-in-the-loop record for review (not a certified compliance product). Egress is allowlisted to the Google Ads + OAuth hosts only (SSRF closed); credentials resolve via BYOK vault at 127.0.0.1 and are never logged (redacted from errors); no subprocess, no filesystem writes. Spend note: budgets/bids are in the ACCOUNTs currency micros, not USD cents, so a numeric cents cap does not map — the airlocks human approval is the authoritative spend gate. Free companion module Google Ads Watch ships the 22 reads at no cost; this paid module adds the 16 airlocked writes. Status: proven live against a real Google Ads test account (API v25), 40/40 commands, building a campaign end to end (budget, campaign, ad group, keywords, ad, state changes); a non-serving test account cannot prove delivery metrics, so result shapes are also locked by the offline contract suite. Independent product; NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC. Google Ads is a trademark of Google LLC, used only to describe compatibility. BYOK. Trust surface: homepage https://github.com/Kxassa/marcofgv-railcall/tree/main/google-ads-airlock, test suite https://github.com/Kxassa/marcofgv-railcall/blob/main/google-ads-airlock/tests/test_handler.py, demo video https://youtu.be/hB-CCsYxsJg, bundle publisher-signed (Ed25519).
